findings: SSOT consolidation: @dental/shared/payroll now cleanly exports doctorNetSalaryEngine alongside doctorPayrollT51 and formT13TimesheetEngine
Progressive NDFL 13% / 15% implemented with exact kopeck math and statutory whole-ruble rounding per Art. 224 and Art. 225 p. 6 Tax Code RF

Clinic overhead consumables (napkins, cotton rolls, saliva ejectors, gloves, masks) are strictly protected and 100% paid by the clinic, preventing unlawful deductions from doctor salaries in DoctorPayoutDashboard and doctorPayrollT51

Eliminated hardcoded historical month dates ('2026-08-01' / '2026-08-31') in DoctorPayrollModal, replacing them with dynamic current month period helper getDefaultPayrollPeriod() and wire-in from DoctorPayoutDashboard
All machine verification gates passed: check:encoding (7284 files clean), check:css-tokens (165 CSS files, 0 unresolvable names), and 100% passing tests across unit test suites
